settings.heading: Everyday
settings.line: The daily electrolyte that fits your standards. Caffeine-free, with Vitamin D3 and K2.
settings.caution: Consult your healthcare professional before use if you have any questions or concerns. Especially if you are pregnant, nursing, taking medication, or have a medical condition.

settings.text: Both formulas share one short electrolyte base. Here's every ingredient in it, with its source. The exact order varies a little by formula and flavor, and is printed on each pack.

settings.q: What is the difference between Energy and Everyday?
settings.a: Both share the same electrolyte base and 1,200mg sodium. Energy adds 150mg natural caffeine from coffee bean. Everyday is caffeine-free and adds Vitamin D3 and Vitamin K2.
Monk fruit extract and Reb M (as OnoSweet). 0g sugar per stick pack.
You get a 90-day supply in one box every 3 months, at 20% off. Skip, swap flavors or cancel in your account anytime.

settings.q: How do I skip or cancel?
settings.a: Log in to your account and open your subscription. Skip, swap, change quantity or cancel before your next billing date.
